publicEvents.summary: Meridian Music released a public teaser for Afterglow’s comeback single, ‘Blue Hour.’ The lead singer on the bridge has not been announced.

posts.text: AFTERGLOW ✦ BLUE HOUR. The first teaser is here.

replies.text: The title card confirms ‘Blue Hour’ is the single name, not the album title.
Purely a guess: that might be Jina on the bridge. The label hasn’t said.
